finding: This commentary critically assesses the generalizability of findings from an uncontrolled retrospective study of procedures done by non-physicians and doctors, and a meta-analysis of non-randomised studies of caesarean sections, to the field of neurosurgery, stating it is a "breath-taking leap" and questions its feasibility.
mod_finding: The commentary specifically highlights findings from a meta-analysis of non-randomised studies on caesarean sections as an example whose generalisation to neurosurgery is critically questioned.
